title: runs/<run-id>/artifacts/data/software.yaml
description: Software development and its evidence under DoWI 8430.01 (S-4, with ART-CMP): the CI/CD pipeline and build, AI in development, the machine-readable software evidence and integrated test and evaluation. SWA-001 and SWA-002 judge it.

covered_software.title: Whether the system includes software the DoW develops, modifies or deploys (covered software)

covered_software_reason.title: Why a hardware product holds no covered software: no firmware, operating system, application or service

pipeline.title: The CI/CD pipeline and build process the software is produced by, treated as critical infrastructure

produced.title: Whether the covered software is produced (developed or built) for the DoW; false when it is wholly acquired

reason.title: How wholly acquired covered software is obtained, where it is not produced

automated.title: Whether a secure, automated CI/CD pipeline integrates, tests, secures and delivers the software

location.title: Where the pipeline runs: a boundary component, or the authorization of the software factory that hosts it

authorization.title: How the pipeline is authorized as critical infrastructure

protection.title: How the pipeline is protected commensurate with mission impact

build.title: The secure, automated and observable build process

trusted_sources.title: How the build ensures the software originates from trusted sources

tamper_protection.title: How the software is protected from tampering during its creation and distribution

observability.title: How the build process is observable

provenance.title: Machine-readable build provenance and the attestations that give pedigree

attestations.title: The attestations that give a cryptographically verifiable chain of custody

signed.title: Whether the attestations are cryptographically signed

supply_chain_links.title: How every link of the software supply chain between writing source code and production deployment is addressed

production_deployment.title: How deployment to production is decided: a manual decision, or automated

practices.title: The secure software development practices the software factory follows

development_tools.title: Development, test, modeling and other enabling systems whose behaviors have security implications for the system, and how they are addressed

ai_development.title: Use of AI to write, modify or test the software

used.title: Whether AI applications or services generate or modify code, scripts or tests for the system

tools.title: AI applications or services used for software development

authorized_by.title: The formal DoW cybersecurity approval that authorizes it for DoW software development

on_dow_system.title: Whether it resides on a DoW information system

no_training_on_data.title: Whether contracts guarantee that government data and prompts are not shared or used to train external models

auditable.title: Whether its use can be audited and monitored by designated authorities

accountability.title: How developers remain accountable for the security, functionality and integrity of code generated or modified using AI

human_review.title: The risk-based review that requires human review and approval of AI-generated changes to security- or safety-critical functionality

review_and_test.title: How AI-generated code is reviewed and security tested as manually written code, for vulnerabilities, safety, logic errors, intellectual property and license obligations

data_protection.title: How non-public DoW information and information about individuals are kept out of unapproved generative AI

training.title: Training of the development team on AI-generated vulnerability patterns, prompt engineering and license contamination

evidence.title: Machine-readable evidence for the software: composition, build integrity and application security

standard.title: The DoW-approved SBOM standard or format

custom_generated.title: Whether an SBOM is generated and maintained for custom software

cots_captured.title: Whether SBOMs are captured for COTS software

third_party_included.title: Whether every third-party component, including open-source software and COTS, is in the SBOM

transitive_included.title: Whether transitive dependencies are in the SBOM

maintained.title: How the SBOM is kept accurate and current

gaps.title: Where the inventory could not be comprehensive, or none

assurance.title: Verifiable assurance evidence produced: static and dynamic code analysis, fuzz testing, penetration testing and secure code review

automation.title: How protections and the generation of assurance evidence are automated

protections_and_risks.title: The applied protections and residual risks, including weaknesses and vulnerabilities, the evidence identifies

ai_record.title: Record of models, versions and significant datasets used to generate or test software

formats.title: The DoW CIO evidence format standards the evidence follows

marking.title: How evidence, SBOMs, provenance and telemetry with sensitive information are marked and handled, and how PII in them is minimized

sharing.title: How the machine-readable evidence is shared to support continuous authorization and reciprocity

assessment_input.title: How the evidence enters risk management and control assessment under the Assess Only construct

test_and_evaluation.title: Integrated and continuous test and evaluation of the software

approach.title: The integrated and continuous T&E approach that unifies DT&E and OT&E

pipeline_integration.title: How operational evaluations integrate with the CI/CD pipeline and accept validated automated test artifacts, scans, performance data and telemetry

operational_data.title: How continuous monitoring, adversarial testing and cyber range data inform operational evaluations of mission risk and resilience

sharing.title: How test data and findings are shared for continuous improvement while protecting sensitive information

contract_performance.title: How testing substantiates contract technical performance requirements, including cybersecurity and cyber resilience

cyber_risk_assessments.title: The mission-based cyber risk assessments that inform the cyber test activities

mission_capability.title: The ongoing evaluations of mission capability, including cybersecurity and cyber resilience

fielding_evidence.title: The formal evidence that supports risk-based fielding decisions

standards.title: The technical standards for security test and validation the software meets

cyber_dte.title: Periodic, independent government cyber DT&E events

independent.title: Whether the event is an independent government event

program.title: The software program: governance adapted to continuous delivery, workforce, records and exceptions to the issuance

governance.title: How acquisition, cybersecurity and T&E governance is adapted to iterative development and continuous delivery, and the governance framework that keeps compliance, risk management and accountability

decision_authority.title: Where decision-making authority is delegated and how operational capability and compliance are verified through automated evidence

workforce.title: The work roles of the DoW Cyber Workforce Framework the software development, security and operations teams fill, and how skill gaps are closed

training.title: Training and education in modern software practices, Agile and DevSecOps, and the continuous learning environment

career_paths.title: Career paths and development opportunities for the software professionals

performance.title: How skills are linked to performance and mission outcomes through regular assessments and clear metrics

records.title: How data and records the software creates or receives are managed through and after its lifespan under approved disposition schedules

exceptions.title: Any exception to DoWI 8430.01 requested through the E2P Portal, or none
